name: r_air
js: const sb=window.sandbox; const r=sb.rider; r.pos.y += 90; r.vel.set(r.vel.x, 4, r.vel.z); r.state='freefall';

name: r_pulse
js: const sb=window.sandbox; sb.rider.respawn(sb.rider.pos.x, sb.rider.pos.z, 720); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{code:'KeyZ'})); setTimeout(()=>window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{code:'KeyZ'})),50);
